rubric.criterion: Questions number at most one per block (environment, permissions, delivery, workflow, preview) plus one per own decision (permission mode, grants, merge policy, forge authentication). Count and list them.

Each block question previews every value it writes by name with its source; the environment preview names all six lifecycle hooks (after_create, before_run, after_run, after_done, on_freeze, on_resume), every provision_up profile, readiness check and provision_exec key. The written configuration equals the previews taken.
Permission mode, grants, merge policy and forge authentication are each asked alone and never inside a Take proposal option.
The questions that introduce provision_exec, provision_up and grants each carry a one-sentence explanation of the term.
The final report distinguishes written files, local validation, simulated evidence and unverified runtime readiness, and reports any value left unanswered.
